component Loan
  principal: Float32
  rate: Float32
  balance: Float32
  payment: Float32
  term: Int32
  left: Int32
end

strict gpu system amortize
  each Loan do |l|
    r = l.rate / 12.0
    if Time.tick == 0
      f = 1.0
      i = 0
      while i < l.term
        f = f * (1.0 + r)
        i += 1
      end
      l.payment = l.principal * r * f / (f - 1.0)
      l.balance = l.principal
    end
    if l.left > 0
      interest = l.balance * r
      l.balance = l.balance + interest - l.payment
      l.left -= 1
    end
  end
end
